remarks: Completely renovated studio in central Norwalk. This residence has been rebuilt from top to bottom, offering a rare opportunity to live in a brand-new space with finishes typically found in larger homes. The kitchen features all-new appliances, modern cabinetry, and a built-in dishwasher. The bathroom has been fully updated with contemporary fixtures and tile.  Additional improvements include new flooring, walls, lighting, and a new heating and cooling system for year-round comfort. A walk-in closet and entry foyer with custom cubbies provide excellent storage an uncommon feature in a studio. Highlights: In-unit washer and dryer Brand-new kitchen and bath Bright, open layout with modern design Convenient location near shops, dining, and transit Studios of this quality are rarely available. Strong credit required; small pets considered.
